verdict.rationale: Kushki documents its own first-party client-side JavaScript library, kushki.js, which is promoted as a PCI-secure integration library and used for the 3DS integration flow. That is an official SDK, but only one, front-end only, and the evidence lists titles rather than SDK reference depth. Missing for 10: server-side SDKs in common languages (e.g. Node, Python, Java), mobile SDKs, SDK reference documentation and versioning details, and independent hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
